title: Videos are refused, other shops' files don't open, removed files are gone
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A video file to attach; an attachment belonging to another shop; and a field whose attachment can be removed.
custom_steps:
1. Upload a video and confirm it is rejected with a reason shown to the author.
2. Attempt to open a file belonging to another shop and confirm it cannot be opened.
3. Remove an attachment from the field and confirm the technician no longer sees it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Video files are rejected, with a reason shown to the author.
  • A file belonging to another shop cannot be opened.
  • If an attachment is removed from the field, the technician no longer sees it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9109 (S11 — Attach a reference file to a question); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S11; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-N1: “Video files will be rejected, with a reason shown to the author”
  • S11-N2: “A file belonging to another shop cannot be opened”
  • S11-N3: “If an attachment is removed from the field, the technician no longer sees it”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
